_open_blockers.repo_visibility: repository is PRIVATE, which is correct during the event. It must be made PUBLIC after the submission deadline or it cannot be evaluated.
_open_blockers.vercel_deployment_protection: RESOLVED: the project shipped with Vercel Authentication on, which answered anonymous callers with a 302 to vercel.com/sso-api. Disabled; verified off via the API. Re-check after any project setting change.
_open_blockers.fallback_is_not_independent: LLM_API_KEY and LLM_FALLBACK_API_KEY in the supplied env file are the SAME VALUE. Pointing the fallback at a different Gemini model does buy a separate per-model daily allowance, which is why it is kept, but it is one key on one project: a revocation, a billing stop or a ban takes both paths down together.
_open_blockers.provider_quota: Free tier. The key answers now, but free-tier daily caps are small and a judged round can exhaust them; a spent quota degrades silently to the regex backup, which does NOT satisfy the mandatory-LLM requirement. Enable billing before the round, and do not spend the day's allowance on casual testing.
_open_blockers.key_exposed_in_chat: The submitted API key was pasted into a chat transcript. It works, so keep it for the round, but ROTATE IT AFTERWARDS at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey.

_fixed_in_release_prep.dockerfile_model: the image defaulted to gemini-3.1-flash-lite, which the README's own measurement records as failing the end-exclusive hour rule ([13,14,15] for 1 PM-3 PM). Corrected to the measured gemini-2.5-flash.
_fixed_in_release_prep.fallback_vendor: four different fallbacks were configured across Dockerfile, .env.example, runtime.env.example and this manifest. Standardised on a DIFFERENT vendor (groq) so the fallback fails independently of the primary; no fallback is baked into the image.
_fixed_in_release_prep.vercel_routing: the first deployments 404'd every route. Vercel detects this project as framework 'fastapi' and serves app/main.py at the root; the api/index.py adapter was never used, and the rewrite in vercel.json replaced the received path so /health arrived as /api/index/health. The functions glob named api/index.py too, so maxDuration:60 never applied and the function ran on the 10s Hobby default against a 6.58s p95.
_fixed_in_release_prep.model_availability: gemini-2.5-flash returns 404 'no longer available to new users' on freshly-created keys, so the configured primary could never have worked on the submitted key. Re-measured and switched to gemini-3.5-flash, which answers every trap note correctly.
_fixed_in_release_prep.gemini3_thinking_budget: CONFIRMED and fixed. Gemini 3 draws thinking from maxOutputTokens; gemini-3.5-flash took 19.0s with 377 thinking tokens on a closed-form extraction, and gemini-3-flash-preview returned no text at all ('no JSON object found'). Setting thinkingConfig.thinkingLevel='low' for gemini-3+ cuts it to 7.1s with every trap still correct.
